components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom navigation, 5 tabs (Home, Explore, Saved, Calendar, Profile). Icons from lucide-react. Active tab colored emerald-500. Container with rounded-t-[28px] and shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgb(0,0,0,0.05)].
components.cards: White background, rounded-[28px], soft shadow. Featured images take up the top half, using object-cover. Info overlays on images should use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/30 text-white).
components.chips: Category and filter chips: rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm bg-white border border-gray-200. Active state: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-500.
components.buttons: Primary buttons: rounded-full bg-emerald-500 text-white px-6 py-3 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-600 transition-all.
components.bottom_sheet: For filters (Age, Indoor/Outdoor, Category). Should slide up from bottom, rounded-t-[32px] with a drag handle (w-12 h-1.5 bg-gray-200 rounded-full mx-auto mt-2).

screens.name: Home
screens.description: Greeting header (e.g., 'Moien!'). Weather Widget showing Luxembourg weather (use emerald gradient). Horizontal scrollable category chips. Vertical feed of 'Featured Activities' using the 28px rounded cards.

screens.name: Explore
screens.description: Sticky header with Search bar and 'Map / List' toggle. Floating action button for Filter bottom sheet. List of activity cards.

screens.name: Saved
screens.description: Tabs (Places, Events, Itineraries). Grid or list of saved items.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.description: Horizontal date selector. Events grouped by time/date below.

screens.name: Profile
screens.description: User info, Language selector (DE/EN/FR), Preferences, Subscription status.

screens.name: Detail
screens.description: Hero image (max-h-[40vh]) with 'glassmorphism' back and save buttons floating on top. Title (34px). Quick info row: Age, Distance, Weather fit. 'Open in Maps' inline map view. 'Book Now' sticky bottom CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Tech Stack: Implement as a mobile-first responsive React web app (matching the Expo/mobile feel) using Tailwind CSS.
Typography: Import and use Manrope for headings and Figtree for body text.
Navigation: Implement a fixed mobile bottom tab navigation bar with 5 tabs.
Design Language: Stick strictly to rounded-[28px] for main cards, soft shadows, generous whitespace, and emerald-500 accents.
Glassmorphism: Use it for image overlays and floating headers.
Testing: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements (e.g. data-testid='home-tab', data-testid='explore-card').
Images: Exclusively use the provided image_urls for activities.
